notes.title: Episodic point and click adventure 'Related' is up on Kickstarter, first chapter free
notes.notes:
Related is a dark episodic point and click adventure that originally had a first episode release back in May 2020, with the team looking for funding to make more episodes.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/episodic-point-and-click-adventure-related-is-up-on-kickstarter-first-chapter-free

notes.title: RELATED is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello dear community![/h3]

It’s Dariia and Andrii here😄

[h3]We are happy to announce that RELATED - a dark and mysterious adventure, is now LIVE on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fractalcatz/related-a-dark-and-mysterious-adventure]Kickstarter[/url]![/h3]

[h3]You can help our project right now here:[/h3] https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fractalcatz/related-a-dark-and-mysterious-adventure

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37639196/03386d432d04fb39d666d13d958ac817510c9745.png[/img]

[h1]Why Kickstarter?[/h1]

We developed the first chapter of the game completely without financial support and released it on Steam this summer. But regrettably, the income from the first chapter is not enough to continue the full development of the game, as we do not have enough money to pay for rent and food. So now we have to additionally work as freelancers, which is why the development takes longer.

We planned to launch a crowdfunding campaign even before we started developing the game. But due to the regional restrictions, we did not have either funds or opportunities to do so. But just recently, Poland, our second home, became available on Kickstarter and now we are here with you!

So, when we collect the required amount on Kickstarter, we will be able to work on the future chapters on a full-time basis instead of only doing it during our leisure periods.

[h3]Thank you for your support! [/h3]

[h3]Lots of Love,[/h3]
Andrii and Dariia
(Fractalcatz)
